description: The Pakistan Bureau of Statistics publishes the detailed results of the 2023 7th Population and Housing Census, the country's first digital census, as Excel and PDF tables at national, province and district level. Housing tables cover type of housing unit, fuel for lighting (electricity, solar panel, other) and cooking (gas, LPG, firewood, other), kitchen, sources of drinking water, structure type, toilets and washrooms, tenure and rooms. Tables 32 to 35 go further, listing each rural mauza by hadbast number and each urban locality with housing units by structure (pacca, semi pacca, kacha) and counts with potable water, electricity, gas, kitchen, bathroom and latrine. Coverage is national: of 38,292,556 households, 32,179,042 used electricity for lighting, 2,962,152 solar panels and 14,485,324 gas for cooking; Islamabad district had 226,022 housing units, 221,669 of them with electricity. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF downloads, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: locality tables are split into one workbook per province; mauza names need matching to boundaries from other sources. Simulation uses: village level shares of homes with electricity, gas and potable water for rural electrification and gas network planning, solar uptake by district, and structure type for flood and earthquake exposure. Related records: the NDMA Pakistan infrastructure risk atlas and the Kenya census 2019 household amenities by sub-county.
